# Employment income
## On this page
- [Salary and wages](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/income-you-must-declare/employment-income#ato-Salaryandwages)
- [Lump sum payments](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/income-you-must-declare/employment-income#ato-Lumpsumpayments)

## Salary and wages
Salary and wage payments you need to declare in your tax return include:

- [income you receive in connection with a joint space and defence project](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/income-you-must-declare/foreign-and-worldwide-income/tax-exempt-income-from-foreign-employment/australia-united-states-joint-space-and-defence-projects) – unless exempt from Australian income tax
- [foreign employment income](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/income-you-must-declare/foreign-and-worldwide-income) – unless exempt from Australian income tax.

If you're an employee of an Australian Government agency (and not a member of a disciplined force), include income you earn from delivering [Australian official development assistance](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/income-you-must-declare/foreign-and-worldwide-income/tax-exempt-income-from-foreign-employment/australia-united-states-joint-space-and-defence-projects).

## Allowances, payments and other work-related income
You may receive allowances, payments or other work-related income that you need to declare in your tax return.

# Taxable, assessable and exempt income
## Assessable income
- salary and wages

You need to declare the market value of these goods or services as assessable income in your tax return.

## Non-assessable, Non-exempt income
Non-assessable, Non-exempt income amounts are those which you [don't include as income](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/income-you-must-declare/amounts-you-do-not-include-as-income) in your tax return.
